translations.web: “ ‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
translations.bsb: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters.
translations.kjv: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
